en: Vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a broad, tree‑lined avenue in a European city, with church spires and historic buildings on both sides and hills in the background. At the top corners are printed words in red, and there is a handwritten date. The reverse side is a classic divided‑back postcard layout with Hungarian text indicating it is a correspondence card published in Pécs.
